So this is one of, if not my favorite by Omopiku. Part 2 has not been uploaded here or any other site from what I can see.
Like the last few doujins Ive uploaded, Ive combined Part 1 and 2 so the viewer can get a seamless “reading” experience.
I hope everyone has a wonderful day and enjoys this fine piece of art 🤭
n: [Misc] [Omopiku] Mom’s Rescued Friend Leaves Her Exhausted! (Part 1 & 2) [Japanese]
